summary: Live-service game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Sea of Thieves
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC Season build with service/account state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with live servers

primary.why: Sea of Thieves is an online shared-world pirate game with ongoing seasons, events, and platform expansion after launch. PC is the best capture/settings route, but season, account progression, crew size, server state, and crossplay must be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC build through Steam/Microsoft Store/Xbox app. Record season/build/date, account state, crew size, solo/safer-seas/high-seas mode, crossplay, cosmetics/progression, event state, and graphics/controller settings.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console-specific crossplay or service state.
secondary.why: PC is easier for capture, but live-service population and control state can vary by platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record season/build, server mode, crew size, event availability, crossplay, and account progression.
